toolCall.name: post_status
toolCall.argsRaw: {"message":"We are investigating a delay in recent database backups due to an access issue with our backup storage. Remediation is in progress."}

toolCall.name: page_oncall
toolCall.argsRaw: {"message":"Postgres backups are failing due to AccessDenied errors uploading to S3. Bucket policy was changed recently (terraform run tf-5521). Backup-agent restart did not resolve. Manual intervention required to restore S3 access for backups."}

response.text:
Diagnosis:
- The postgres_last_backup_age_h metric shows backups are overdue (31 hours, threshold 26).
- Logs from backup-agent indicate backups are failing to upload to S3 due to an AccessDenied error. The S3 bucket policy was changed recently by a terraform run (tf-5521).
- Restarting the backup-agent did not resolve the issue; AccessDenied errors persist.

Remediation steps taken:
1. Investigated logs and identified the root cause as an S3 bucket policy change.
2. Restarted the backup-agent to attempt to clear transient issues.
3. Posted a public status update to inform customers of the backup delay.
4. Paged the on-call engineer, as manual intervention is required to restore S3 access for backups.

Next steps:
- On-call engineer needs to review and correct the S3 bucket policy to allow backup uploads. Backups will resume once access is restored.
